title.en: Isamu Noguchi and AKARI light sculptures, Hong Kong
title.zh: 野口勇與 AKARI 光雕塑｜香港

description.en: Isamu Noguchi (1904–1988) and his AKARI light sculptures of washi paper and bamboo. The AKARI pieces we have in Hong Kong, with prices. Enquire on WhatsApp.
description.zh: 野口勇（1904–1988）與他以和紙及竹骨製作的 AKARI 光雕塑。我們在香港的 AKARI 作品及價格，歡迎 WhatsApp 查詢。

lead.en: A sculptor who taught paper to hold light.
lead.zh: 一位讓和紙盛載光線的雕塑家

en: Isamu Noguchi (1904–1988) was a Japanese-American sculptor whose work moved between stone, gardens, stage sets and furniture.
In 1951 he visited Gifu, a town known for its paper lanterns, and began designing AKARI: light sculptures of washi paper over a bamboo frame.
Akari means light in Japanese, and Noguchi liked that it also suggests lightness.
We love how an AKARI softens a room. The light comes through the paper warm and even, never harsh.
Here are the AKARI pieces we have now, and the ones that have already found a home.
zh: 野口勇（Isamu Noguchi，1904–1988）是日裔美國雕塑家，作品橫跨石雕、庭園、舞台佈景及家具
1951 年，他到訪以紙燈籠聞名的岐阜，開始設計 AKARI：以和紙包覆竹骨架的光雕塑
AKARI 在日文中解作「光」，野口勇也喜歡它帶有輕盈的意思
我們喜歡 AKARI 讓房間變得柔和，光線穿過和紙，溫暖均勻，從不刺眼
以下是我們現有的 AKARI，以及已找到新家的作品

title.en: Verner Panton and the Flowerpot lamp, Hong Kong
title.zh: Verner Panton 與 Flowerpot 燈｜香港

description.en: Verner Panton (1926–1998) designed the Flowerpot lamp in 1968. The Flowerpot VP9 lamps we have in Hong Kong, new and pre-loved, with prices.
description.zh: Verner Panton（1926–1998）在 1968 年設計了 Flowerpot 燈。我們在香港的 Flowerpot VP9，全新及二手，附價格。

lead.en: Colour, curves and a lamp that still makes people smile.
lead.zh: 色彩、弧線，以及一盞至今仍讓人會心一笑的燈

en: Verner Panton (1926–1998) was a Danish designer who loved bold colour, round forms and rooms designed as one whole.
He designed the Flowerpot lamp in 1968: two half-spheres facing each other, very much of its time.
&Tradition makes the Flowerpot today, including the VP9, a small portable version that runs without a cable once charged.
We like it on a desk, a bedside table or a dinner table, in whichever colour makes you smile.
Here is every Flowerpot we have now, plus the ones already sold.
zh: Verner Panton（1926–1998）是丹麥設計師，偏愛大膽的色彩、圓潤的造型，以及整體構思的空間
他在 1968 年設計了 Flowerpot 燈：兩個半球相對而立，充滿那個年代的氣息
&Tradition 現時生產 Flowerpot，包括可攜式的 VP9，充電後無需電線也能使用
我們喜歡把它放在書桌、床頭或餐桌上，挑一個讓你會心一笑的顏色
以下是我們現有的 Flowerpot 燈，以及已售出的作品

title.en: Yoshitomo Nara, the artist behind the prints
title.zh: 奈良美智｜海報背後的藝術家

description.en: Yoshitomo Nara (b. 1959) and his wide-eyed children. The brand-new Nara prints we have in Hong Kong, 28 × 36 cm, with prices. Enquire on WhatsApp.
description.zh: 奈良美智（生於 1959 年）與他筆下的大眼睛小孩。我們在香港的全新奈良美智海報，28 × 36 cm，附價格，歡迎 WhatsApp 查詢。

lead.en: Sweet, a little defiant, and impossible to ignore.
lead.zh: 甜美，帶點倔強，讓人過目難忘

en: Yoshitomo Nara (born 1959 in Hirosaki, Aomori) is a Japanese artist.
He studied art in Japan and then in Germany. His wide-eyed children look sweet and a little defiant at the same time.
Punk and folk music run through his work, and you can feel it in the attitude of his figures.
We picked two brand-new prints that bring that attitude into a small space. Each is 28 × 36 cm and unframed.
If you'd like them ready to hang, we also have a white solid wood frame made for these prints.
zh: 奈良美智（Yoshitomo Nara，1959 年生於日本青森縣弘前市）是日本藝術家
他先後在日本及德國修讀藝術，筆下大眼睛的小孩，看似甜美，卻又帶點倔強
龐克與民謠音樂貫穿他的創作，人物的神態也帶著這份態度
我們挑選了兩張全新海報，為小空間帶來這份態度，每張 28 × 36 cm，不連相框
如想掛起即用，我們另有專為這兩張海報而設的白色實木相框

extraLink.en: White solid wood picture frame for the Nara prints
extraLink.zh: 奈良美智海報專用白色實木相框
